image_description: A highly ornate, gilded Baroque-style altar (reredos) situated within a church sanctuary. The structure features a central niche with a statue, flanked by twisted Solomonic columns and elaborate gold leaf carvings. Above the main section is a large, semi-circular stained glass window or fanlight. The altar table itself is covered with a white cloth and adorned with a large arrangement of green foliage and flowers. Tall, narrow windows flank the altar on the left and right walls.
